templateIntro: Template hooks: each example calls the real API. Theme and layout preferences are saved; use the corresponding reset actions to restore them.
webIntro: Web and component hooks: interactive examples, reactive results and minimal usage snippets.
captureTarget: Local example content for element fullscreen, image capture and printing.
capturePreview: PNG capture of the example content
rightClick: Right-click here to open the menu. Click outside or press Esc to close.

descriptions.useTheme: Switch themes and read the current theme. System mode keeps responding to OS theme changes.
descriptions.useSpinning: Control the content loading overlay or remount the current page. The latest reload controls when content returns.
descriptions.useMaximize: Maximize layout content. Pages, tab menus and restore controls share the same state. Esc restores it.
descriptions.useBadge: Show, update or hide a menu badge by path, including its icon.
descriptions.useWatermark: Update the global watermark and control visibility. An empty string keeps the previous text.
descriptions.useAppNavigation: Navigate by menu object, full path or zero-based top-level index. Returns an awaitable navigation result.
descriptions.useSiderBar: Close tabs and their neighbors by path, index or tab object.
descriptions.useContentScroll: Obtain a scroll function in setup. Each call resolves the current layout instance.
descriptions.useSiderScroll: Scroll the current sidebar. Safely does nothing when top navigation has no sidebar.
descriptions.useDevice: Observe viewport size and apply a custom tablet breakpoint. Resize the window to see changes.
descriptions.usePagination: Bind pagination to Naive UI. Page-size changes reset the page; resetting also invokes the business callback.
descriptions.useDayjs: Format dates, calculate day differences, test exclusive ranges and obtain today’s boundaries.
descriptions.useI18n: Use namespaced or full translation keys. The settings store synchronizes locale across the app.
descriptions.useVueRouter: Access the same Router inside or outside setup, including its reactive current route.
descriptions.useElementFullscreen: Maximize an element with CSS. Exit or scope disposal restores its original styles.
descriptions.useDomToImage: Capture the area above. Configure a default format or override it in create. Errors appear below.
descriptions.usePrint: Pass an element ref to print-js. The button opens the browser’s print interface.
descriptions.useContextmenuCoordinate: Track right-click coordinates for NDropdown, with outside-click dismissal and complete listener cleanup.
